name: Jesse
bio:
Jesse is the son of Obed and the father of King David, named here only in Ruth's closing genealogy (4:17, 22) as part of the line descending from Boaz and Ruth. He was a respected man of Bethlehem with eight sons.

The LORD sent Samuel to Bethlehem to anoint a new king among Jesse's sons. Jesse had his seven older sons pass before Samuel one by one, but each time Samuel said the LORD had not chosen them. Samuel asked Jesse, "Are these all the sons you have?" and Jesse answered, "There is still the youngest, but he is tending the sheep" — only then remembering his youngest son, left out of the gathering. Samuel insisted he be sent for at once, and they would not sit down to eat until he arrived; when this shepherd boy, David, was brought in, the LORD told Samuel, "Rise and anoint him; this is the one" (1 Samuel 16:1-13). Jesse's near-oversight of his youngest son, simply because of birth order, highlights how God chooses not by human convention but according to his own heart.
